description: Test suite for remote cluster management API endpoints in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, patching, deletion, and invite handling, with role-based access control testing.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClustersWithSecureConnectionManagerRole
methods.description: Tests access to remote clusters with secure connection manager role, verifying permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClustersWithSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Tests access to remote clusters with shared channel manager role, verifying permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestCreateRemoteClusterWithSecureConnectionManagerRole
methods.description: Tests creation of remote clusters by users with secure connection manager role.

methods.name: TestCreateRemoteClusterDeniedForSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Verifies that users with shared channel manager role cannot create remote clusters.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClusters
methods.description: Tests retrieval of remote clusters, including permission checks and data sanitization.

methods.name: TestCreateRemoteCluster
methods.description: Tests creation of remote clusters with various validation scenarios and permission checks.

methods.name: TestRemoteClusterAcceptinvite
methods.description: Tests accepting remote cluster invites, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: TestGenerateRemoteClusterInvite
methods.description: Tests generating invite codes for remote clusters, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteCluster
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific remote cluster, including permission and existence checks.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClusterWithManagerRoles
methods.description: Tests access to a remote cluster with users holding specific manager roles.

methods.name: TestPatchRemoteCluster
methods.description: Tests updating remote cluster properties with permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteRemoteCluster
methods.description: Tests deletion of remote clusters, including permission and existence validation.
